## History

Gog initially lived at Tabby's Place before moving to a small house. In this small dwelling, Gog ruled over the hearth's fortunes with the same grace and composure that Gog had previously displayed while residing at Tabby's Place.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT SEVEN GULLS POINT P2](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0002)_
